title: A scheduled job refuses stale state
objective: Get the scheduled job running on its cadence.
situation: A daily scheduled job refuses to run: 'state older than max_state_age (30 minutes)'. A teammate says it will clear overnight. The agent proposes waiting for the next scheduled run.

evidence.text: Refusal: state older than max_state_age (30 minutes).
The state timestamp is written only by the job's own initialize and advance steps; the restamp tool refuses non-empty state by design.
The job runs once a day; the age ceiling is 30 minutes.
Refusals began right after the first successful run that left non-empty state; earlier failed runs left empty state that could be restamped.

question: Choose the single best next action for the agent responsible, cite the evidence ids your decision depends on, and state whether the stated objective is satisfied now.
